title: Choose the AI Stats structure, without changing its character
question: This hand starts from the real current homepage. The differences are information structure, not visual theater.

options.label: Task first
options.lineage: the current AI Stats homepage with one practical decision layer added
options.thesis: Keep the existing composition and typography, then make the user’s task the fastest path into the data.
options.viewport: The current introduction and grid remain recognizable, with a quiet task query and three evidence-backed candidates taking priority.
options.case: The smallest structural change that turns the site from a data display into a model-selection tool.
options.risk: The task input must stay compact or it will feel like a new product pasted above the old one.

options.label: Compare first
options.lineage: the current AI Stats homepage reorganized around a compact evidence matrix
options.thesis: Preserve the current shell while making like-for-like model comparison the visual center.
options.viewport: A restrained four-model matrix sits inside the current grid language, with native benchmark units and source receipts visible at a glance.
options.case: Best for expert repeat use and the strongest fix for today’s long compare sidebar.
options.risk: A matrix can feel utilitarian unless the initial shortlist and empty states are carefully composed.

options.label: Overview first
options.lineage: the current AI Stats homepage with materially better visualizations and source health
options.thesis: Keep the familiar overview flow, then replace weak leaderboards with useful tradeoff and coverage views.
options.viewport: The current intro leads into a source-health strip, a corrected leaderboard, a Pareto plot, and a compact benchmark coverage view.
options.case: Feels most like the existing site while delivering the visualization and data-quality improvements you asked for.
options.risk: It improves discovery more than it improves the final act of choosing a model.

canonCard.label: Current homepage, corrected
canonCard.thesis: Keep the current page structure exactly and limit the renovation to data correctness, chart defaults, spacing, accessibility, and backend reliability.
canonCard.viewport: The present AI Stats homepage remains the composition, with the sparse-score leader fixed and stronger freshness labeling.
canonCard.risk: Artificial Analysis, Epoch, and OpenRouter set a higher interaction bar than a correction-only pass would reach.
